findings.title: The PR list is the 20 most recently created, not updated, so older open PRs will fall off the board and out of Needs attention once the repo passes 20 PRs

evidence.value: Contents: the 20 most recently updated pull requests, in any state.

findings.impact: Once there are more than 20 PRs, an older-created PR that is still open is left out of the panel and out of Needs attention (AC-P4). Latent today.
findings.remediation: Add '--search', 'sort:updated-desc' to PR_LIST; update GH_ARGS in tests, the comment and the CLAUDE.md row; keep the client-side sort as a safety net.

findings.title: A lookalike-host regression in the page's only link guard would pass the suite: no test uses a github.com-prefixed non-GitHub URL

evidence.value: startsWith('https://github.com') still passes all 55 page checks

findings.impact: A future edit that drops the trailing slash or relaxes the check would ship an off-site link without failing the suite.
findings.remediation: Add rows with https://github.com.evil.example/..., http://github.com/..., https://github.com@evil.example/...; assert they render as text in the panel and Needs attention; re-run the mutation.

findings.title: A PR whose state is an inherited object key (constructor, __proto__, toString) makes the GitHub tab fail to draw
findings.impact: The per-tab try/catch contains it, but the whole GitHub tab shows an error and the page logs console.error. Hard to reach.
findings.remediation: Guard with Object.hasOwn or a Map; add a page check with an inherited-key state.
